question: Where are a restaurant available within a 110 kilometers radius of Shavers Creek Environmental Center, Petersburg, PA?
sql: SELECT poi_name, addr_state, addr_city, cuisine FROM pois WHERE amenity = 'restaurant' AND ST_DWithin(geometry::geography, ( SELECT geometry::geography FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Shavers Creek Environmental Center%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%Petersburg%' AND addr_state ILIKE '%PA%' LIMIT 1 ), 110000) ORDER BY ST_Distance(geometry::geography, ( SELECT geometry::geography FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Shavers Creek Environmental Center%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%Petersburg%' AND addr_state ILIKE '%PA%' LIMIT 1 )) ASC;
